business_summary: Jilin Jian Yisheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, wholesale, retail, import, and export of pharmaceutical products in China. The company offers drugs comprising capsules, injections, tablets, granules, and other drug products; cosmetics; ginseng products; bee products; and food products comprising acai collagen solid drinks, multivitamin mineral tablets, collagen peptide juice drinks, and fruit lemon powder. It is also involved in pharmaceutical contract manufacturing; production of health food, food, health care products; special medical products; production of fertilizers and beverages; sale of food through the internet; planting and production of Chinese medicinal herbs extracts; wholesale and retail of cosmetics; road freight transportation; research and development of bio-organic and microbial fertilizers; non-residential real estate, machinery, and equipment leasing; packaging printing; paper cutting and sales; development and application of human stem cell technology; and the traditional spice products business. In addition, the company provides life beauty services; Chinese medicine health and wellness services; and technical development, consulting, exchange, promotion, and transfer services. Jilin Jian Yisheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Ji'an, China.
